name: Youtube Reporting
shortInfo: YouTube Reporting retrieves bulk reports containing YouTube Analytics data.
brief: YouTube Reporting retrieves bulk reports containing YouTube Analytics data for a channel or content owner.
about:
YouTube Reporting used to better understand user activity and your video and channel performance. The YouTube Reporting connector enables you to retrieve predefined reports that contain a comprehensive set of YouTube Analytics data for a channel.

Check more about YouTube Reporting api documentaion [here](https://developers.google.com/youtube/reporting/v1/reports).
availableData:
[Channel Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/youtube-reporting/pipelines/channel-report.html)

This pipeline can be used by channel owners to request and retrieve various predefined video and playlist reports from the YouTube Reporting platform.
